note: v1: THE NOTE IN THE SILENCE, deep hypnotic house in D# minor, 122 rising to 122.5, built on THE ZWICKER TONE: after seconds of loud noise with a notch cut in it, a faint tone is heard in the silence that follows, at a pitch inside the notch, and nothing plays it. Four breaks: noise with a third-octave notch (measured 39 dB deep) swells for three bars, then a whole bar of digital silence (measured: -240 dB for three and a half beats) in which the ear hears the missing note; the music returns with a glockenspiel playing exactly that note, so the phantom turns real (each notch sits a little above its note, where the after-tone falls). The four notches are THE STAIR, D# F F# A#: the tape's thread heard as after-tones in four silences, and after the last one the bell plays the whole stair. Between them a deep groove: a reese bass on a seven-bar filter LFO, a Rhodes on the sixteenth 'a's, a rim on a dotted-eighth cycle running across the bar lines, the bell keeping every step it has been given. Each break has its own colour under the noise (a reese drone, the Rhodes held, the bell's earlier steps). Seeds 0/11: 89.84 / 88.93; -11.0 LUFS, TP -1.29, runs 1; rhythm 65 (the dotted-eighth rim isn't registering as off-grid yet) and flow 47 are next.

The fourth break's silence now lasts two bars instead of one: the noise with the notch at A# swells for three bars, the bell's echoes of the three earlier steps fade through the first silent bar, and the second is nearly pure silence (measured -55 to -77 dB) - the last after-tone of the stair heard alone - before the glockenspiel at last plays the whole stair, D# F F# A#, and the peak begins a bar later. note: v6: THE AFTER-TONES TOGETHER. Each of the four silences gave one note the ear heard and nothing played (D#, F, F#, A#: the stair); now, under the peak (bars 142-152), those four notes sound at last as ONE chord - D#4 F4 F#4 A#4 with D#5 above, a pad held in two long swells while its low-pass opens 1.6 octaves - the phantoms made real together, the form's payoff after the bell's whole stair. Measured on a common scale (loudness off): the chord alone -20.5 dB in its band (280-1000 Hz) against -18.7 for the whole mix there: it carries most of that band through the peak. Seeds 0/11 (v5 92.83 / 92.85): 92.91 / 92.93; levels clean (-11.0 LUFS, TP -1.29, runs 1).

note: v7: THE NOTCH CLIMBS THE STAIR. The noise lived only inside the breaks and the drop simply stopped when the last one came. Now in the eight bars before the final break (129-136) a noise wash rises under the groove with its notch GLIDING from D# up the stair to A# (0.58 octaves, three notches together), a high-pass sweeping up and the wash growing - a riser built from the illusion's own material - and at 137 it becomes the last break's noise, already notched at A#, before the two bars of silence. The ear is led up the stair to the last after-tone. Measured on the riser alone: the notch's centre ~710 Hz at bar 129, ~768 at 132, on its way to A#; it also fills the 2-5 kHz the track lacked (spectrum 85.7 -> 87.6). note: v8 (judgment keep for Harry's 15:00 steer; the guardrail fell 2.4): THE SILENCES COME INTO THE GROOVE, and DARKER. Harry: most tracks have no illusion between their moments, and the chords are too basic; chirp-eco's survey had t10's illusion near the front for only 10-15% of the track with 76 s gaps. Now: (1) every eight bars of groove a two-beat burst of noise notched at the NEXT break's note, then beat one of the next bar a HOLE (everything out): a one-beat after-tone flickering in the groove, foreshadowing the stair - and subtly off; (2) a quiet notched-noise BED under each groove section carrying that section's coming note, breathing on a seven-bar LFO, swelling into its break, and back on D# under the outro (a circle); (3) darker chords: D#m9 | Emaj7#11 (the Phrygian bII) | Bmaj7 with a hidden minor second (A# against B) | A#7b9, and a D# PEDAL in the reese under them through A and B. Measured (chirpers.py illusion, the noise, hints, beds and the after-tone chord): presence 15% -> 36%, longest stretch without 76 s -> 44 s (now only the seam's intro and outro); spectrum 87.6 -> 97.5; but cohesion 77 and variety 88 (the hiss and the darker colour move t10 away from the album's average): seeds 0/11 90.59 / 90.19 (v7 93.02).
